metadata.title: Groupicorn Maine IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. September 22, 2026 research checked current official program and address pages for Augusta, Bangor, Biddeford-Saco, and Lewiston-Auburn; these records remain a focused regional pass, not statewide re-verification. Logo-pending candidates remain queued.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url points to a tracked PNG asset. Existing asset provenance and license clearance require separate review where source URLs are not yet recorded.
metadata.geocoding_note: Street addresses and ZIP codes are stored where sourced; coordinates are intentionally null pending an audited geocoding pass.
metadata.publication_warning: Verify current program availability, age/track eligibility, insurance, intake requirements, and accepting-patient status before public display or referral use.

research_queue.name: Acadia adult IOP local status
research_queue.task: Recheck whether Acadia currently offers an in-person adult IOP at the Bangor site. The pediatric IOP is supported locally; the adult IOP flyer found in this pass describes virtual programming and should not be used to expand the local adult record.
